# Use the tagged MIME closure conversion and handle its failure

Current parse_buffer implementations obtain MimeObject through MimeClosure.AsMimeObject and return a failure if it is null. MimeClosure checks its stored tag, asserts on a mismatch in debug and returns null in release. Use the existing typed conversion for this callback boundary instead of a raw cast, and preserve the runtime null guard as well as the assertion. This protects type selection, not pointer lifetime or a proof that all MIME closure call sites are safe.

Scope: mailnews/mime/src.
